from .errors import BillingError

from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

def expect(code, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except BillingError as e:
        assert e.code == code, (e.code, code)
        print("ok", code)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("no error for "+code)

# zero
p = Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
expect("non_positive_amount", lambda: refund_shipping(p, Decimal("0"), T0))
# negative
expect("non_positive_amount", lambda: refund_shipping(p, Decimal("-1"), T0))
# non-captured
for st in ("authorized","voided","refunded"):
    p2 = Payment("p2","i",Decimal("100.00"),status=st)
    expect("invalid_state", lambda p2=p2: refund_shipping(p2, Decimal("1"), T0))
# over-refund
p3 = Payment("p3","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund_shipping(p3, Decimal("60"), T0)
expect("refund_exceeds_captured", lambda: refund_shipping(p3, Decimal("50"), T0))
# full refund sets status
refund_shipping(p3, Decimal("40"), T0)
assert p3.status == "refunded" and p3.refunded_amount == Decimal("100.00")
print("full refund ok")
# approval
p4 = Payment("p4","i",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
expect("approval_required", lambda: refund_shipping(p4, Decimal("600"), T0))
refund_shipping(p4, Decimal("600"), T0, approved_by="mgr")
print("approval ok")
# idempotency
p5 = Payment("p5","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund_shipping(p5, Decimal("10"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
refund_shipping(p5, Decimal("10"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert p5.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00")
print("idempotency ok")
EOF"}
